narr: Showers and thunderstorms developed near a boundary over central Virginia. Anomalous moisture was present, and the storm motion was slow which led to areas of flooding and flash flooding.
ev: Glade Road was caved in where Buffalo Creek Stream intersections the road north of the James River Road. A car was also stuck in flood waters near the caved in portion of the road.
Water was about 1 foot deep flowing over roads around Roseland. Cattle were stranded in flood waters as well.
Water was flowing over Route 29 around Town Creek.
lsr: GLADE ROAD CAVED IN WHERE BUFFALO CREEK STREAM INTERSECTS THE ROAD ABOUT A HALF MILE NORTH OF JAMES RIVER ROAD. CAR ALSO REPORTED STUCK IN FLOOD WATERS NEAR CAVED IN PORTION OF GLADE ROAD.
